params.name: scope
params.description: scope here is resourceId for which alert is created.

params.name: targetResource
params.description: Filter by target resource( which is full ARM ID) Default value is select all.

params.name: targetResourceType
params.description: Filter by target resource type. Default value is select all.

params.name: targetResourceGroup
params.description: Filter by target resource group name. Default value is select all.

params.name: monitorService
params.description: Filter by monitor service which generates the alert instance. Default value is select all.

params.name: monitorCondition
params.description: Filter by monitor condition which is either 'Fired' or 'Resolved'. Default value is to select all.

params.name: severity
params.description: Filter by severity.  Default value is select all.

params.name: alertState
params.description: Filter by state of the alert instance. Default value is to select all.

params.name: alertRule
params.description: Filter by specific alert rule.  Default value is to select all.

params.name: smartGroupId
params.description: Filter the alerts list by the Smart Group Id. Default value is none.

params.name: includeContext
params.description: Include context which has contextual data specific to the monitor service. Default value is false'

params.name: includeEgressConfig
params.description: Include egress config which would be used for displaying the content in portal.  Default value is 'false'.

params.name: pageCount
params.description: Determines number of alerts returned per page in response. Permissible value is between 1 to 250. When the "includeContent"  filter is selected, maximum value allowed is 25. Default value is 25.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Sort the query results by input field,  Default value is 'lastModifiedDateTime'.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort the query results order in either ascending or descending.  Default value is 'desc' for time fields and 'asc' for others.

params.name: select
params.description: This filter allows to selection of the fields(comma separated) which would  be part of the essential section. This would allow to project only the  required fields rather than getting entire content.  Default is to fetch all the fields in the essentials section.

params.name: timeRange
params.description: Filter by time range by below listed values. Default value is 1 day.

params.name: customTimeRange
params.description: Filter by custom time range in the format <start-time>/<end-time>  where time is in (ISO-8601 format)'. Permissible values is within 30 days from  query time. Either timeRange or customTimeRange could be used but not both. Default is none.

items.docs: List all existing alerts, where the results can be filtered on the basis of multiple parameters (e.g. time range). The results can then be sorted on the basis specific fields, with the default being lastModifiedDateTime.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for this operation.

items.docs: This operation allows replacing, merging or selectively deleting tags on the specified resource or subscription. The specified entity can have a maximum of 50 tags at the end of the operation. The 'replace' option replaces the entire set of existing tags with a new set. The 'merge' option allows adding tags with new names and updating the values of tags with existing names. The 'delete' option allows selectively deleting tags based on given names or name/value pairs.
